evals.name: valkey-cache-client
evals.prompt: Connect to Valkey using the official valkey-go client and implement key-value caching with TTL.
evals.expected_output: Client initialization with valkey.NewClient and executing Set / Get commands with context.
assertions: Executes Set with Expiration using valkey-go builder API.
Handles cache miss when key does not exist.

evals.name: valkey-atomic-operations
evals.prompt: Implement an atomic rate-limiter counter with expiration in Valkey.
evals.expected_output: Using Valkey pipeline or atomic INCR with EXPIRE.
assertions: Sets TTL on key creation to prevent orphaned counters.

evals.name: valkey-failover-resilience
evals.prompt: Configure Valkey client connection timeouts, retries, and circuit breaking for high availability.
evals.expected_output: Client options configuration with connection timeout, read/write timeouts, and fallback handling.
assertions: Sets DialTimeout and Read/Write timeouts in ClientOption.
Handles connection failure with graceful fallback to source-of-truth database.
Prevents Valkey slowness from cascading into thread pool exhaustion.
